verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents its own full-text thread search across sender, recipients, subject and body, with results ranked by relevance. Threads can be retrieved scoped to a single inbox or across the whole organization, which covers ranked keyword search over mail history. The LangChain vector-store recipe is a developer building block and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented search operators/query syntax, explicit filter parameters (date, label, sender) combined with search, any evidence on search speed or latency, independent or hands-on corroboration.
